cover_letter_text:
Hi,

My name's Marc. I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering, and in February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design. You're looking for a junior or graduate project engineer in your civil construction team that works with local councils and tier one firms in South Australia, and I'd like to be considered.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on two building sites in the Philippines, first as project-in-charge and then as field engineer. I coordinated crews, did site inspections and quality checks, and kept progress and material records. In the diploma I designed roads, earthworks and drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D.

I will relocate to Adelaide for this role and can start three weeks after an offer. I have a White Card, a full Victorian driver's licence, and full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa). Happy to chat any time.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
